newsitem.title: USA: Capital Growth cuts stake in UAL Corp.
newsitem.headline: Capital Growth cuts stake in UAL Corp.

text.p: Captial Growth Management LP said in a Securities and Exchange Commission 13G filing on Tuesday that it had cut its stake in UAL Corp to 7.35 percent, down from 14.88 percent reported on February 12.
The number of UAL shares held by Capital Growth rose, to 4,245,700 from 1,885,000. A spokeswoman for Capital Growth said the rise reflected a four-for-one stock split last May.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, these reports do not list the latest transactions.
